name: Behind the Deal
controllingIdea: The work that happens off-stage often determines on-stage success.

narrativeArc.incitingIncident: A deal closes - but there's more to the story than meets the eye
narrativeArc.risingAction: Reveal the hidden challenges that nearly derailed everything
narrativeArc.crisis: The moment that could have ended the deal
narrativeArc.climax: How expertise and effort saved the day
narrativeArc.resolution: Client is home, lessons are crystallized, trust is earned

questions.question: Tell us about the client and their initial goals.
questions.purpose: Set up the characters and stakes
questions.placeholder: First-time buyers looking for a starter home under $400k...

questions.question: What hidden challenge or surprise came up during the transaction?
questions.placeholder: Inspection revealed foundation issues that the seller didn't disclose...

questions.question: What was the moment it could have fallen apart?
questions.placeholder: The seller refused to negotiate and we were 48 hours from losing earnest money...

questions.question: How did you navigate and resolve the challenge?
questions.placeholder: I brought in a structural engineer and negotiated a $15k credit...

questions.question: What was the final outcome and what insight would you share?
questions.placeholder: They closed last Friday and are thrilled. The lesson: always get a thorough inspection...

promptConfig.systemContext: This is a competence story. Show the agent's value through a specific challenge they navigated. The goal is to build trust by revealing expertise.
promptConfig.toneGuidance: Professional but personable. Show skill without arrogance. Let the problem-solving speak for itself.

slideStructure.contentFocus: The surface story vs. hidden reality
Who they are and what they wanted
What went wrong or could have

usageHints: Wait until client is comfortable sharing the story
Focus on one specific challenge, not every hiccup
The lesson should be useful to future clients
Don't oversell your role - let the story show your value

exampleScenarios.title: Appraisal Gap Crisis
exampleScenarios.situation: Home appraised $30k under contract price, threatening to kill the deal
exampleScenarios.sampleInput: My buyers were under contract at $530k but the appraisal came in at $500k. Sellers wouldn't budge. I pulled comps, wrote a rebuttal, and got it reappraised at $525k. We split the remaining $5k.

expectedOutput.hook: The appraisal came back $30k short. Here's what happened next.
expectedOutput.keyMoment: A thorough rebuttal and the right comps changed everything.
